body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Preverco, a leading manufacturer of high-end, Canadian hardwood flooring, announced its Verywood line of hardwood flooring. Unveiled at Surfaces 2009, the company is now offering Wirescraped finish with its Verywood product line. Preverco's Wirescraped finish is additionally available in three new colors: Grizzly, Kodiak and Black Bear.

VeryWood, an entry-level product line, is available in red oak, hard maple and yellow birch. With Three Widths (2"1/4, 3"1/4 and 4"1/4) and four popular colors to choose from, Verywood provides an affordable and rustic-looking option to consumers.

The new line was developed in response to growing market demand for a lower priced hardwood option. Preverco aims to meet the industry's need for an entry-level product line with its Verywood offering, as retailers and distributors report a growing market share for products at this price point.

Preverco's Verywood Premium line of hardwood flooring is available in a 30 degree satin gloss finish, This satin gloss finish proved its popularity with the manufacturer's Engenius Series of engineered hardwood.
